seo.title: Be Tulum Honeymoon Review: Adults-Only Jungle Beach 2026
seo.description: Adults-only 64-suite jungle beach icon on Tulum strip. Score 87/100, from $700/night. Honest verdict, suite pick.

content.verdict: Be Tulum is the original Tulum-strip icon — the property that defined the global "jungle meets beach, candlelit, all-natural materials, adults-only" aesthetic that has been copied by a thousand resorts since. 64 suites and villas on the Tulum beach road, mostly with private plunge pools, all walled with vines and driftwood, lit at night by what feels like a thousand candles. It is adults-only. The beach is one of the loveliest stretches of the Tulum zone. The Yäan Wellness spa is genuinely excellent. The hotel's sand-floor bar with hammocks is among the most photographed bars in Mexico. Caveats: the Tulum strip's sargassum issue varies year to year, and Be Tulum's barriers are good but not Belmond-level. The grid-power-vs-solar setup means some suites are warmer than others in summer (visit Nov–March). Service is laid-back-Tulum, not Belmond-precise. But for the original jungle-beach Tulum honeymoon — and for the iconic Be Tulum candlelit-bar evenings — this is the address.
content.best_room: Beachfront Suite with private plunge pool (90 m², direct beach view from the bed). Jungle Suite with plunge for the inland-private experience. Avoid garden-view standard rooms — they miss the Tulum point.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival via Cancún
itinerary_7_nights.description: 90-min CUN transfer to Tulum strip. Greeted with mezcal and copal-incense. Settle into Beachfront Suite. Sunset at the sand-floor swing bar. Dinner at Be Tulum's in-house restaurant.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Beach and Tulum ruins
itinerary_7_nights.description: Tulum ruins at 8am opening (10 min north). Private guide. Return for late breakfast. Beach day. Sunset at the bar. Hartwood dinner.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Cenote private day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Private guide and snorkel at Gran Cenote (15 min). Picnic lunch. Afternoon Yäan spa couples' massage. Dinner at Posada Margherita.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Sian Ka'an
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full-day Muyil drift snorkel and biosphere boat. Return at sunset. Casa Jaguar dinner with live jazz.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Beach and bar
itinerary_7_nights.description: Slow morning. Floating breakfast in your plunge pool. Long lunch at Mateo's Tulum nearby. Sunset cocktails at the iconic swing bar. Dinner at Arca (Tulum).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full day at Yäan Wellness — hammam, couples' temazcal, massage. Final dinner at Hartwood (if you booked the second seating) or at Cetli for the local-Mexican option.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Slow departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Late breakfast at your plunge pool. Final swim in the Tulum Caribbean. CUN transfer for departure.

caveats: Tulum strip sargassum varies — Be Tulum has barriers but not at Belmond Maroma scale.
Solar/generator power means some suites warmer than others in summer; book Nov–March.
Service is laid-back Tulum, not Belmond-precise.
The strip is busy and increasingly built-up — quieter walks toward Sian Ka'an end.
Wifi is intentionally weak — embrace the digital detox or bring backup.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Excellent — adults-only, jungle-beach aesthetic, plunge pools, candlelit at night. The definitive Tulum honeymoon.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: November to mid-April. Outside that window the heat and sargassum make Tulum strip miserable.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: 4–6 months for Beachfront Suites with plunge pool in winter peak.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: Yes — strict adults-only, 18+ across the property.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Beachfront Suite with private plunge pool.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: CUN private transfer 90 min ($150–$180). Or Tulum airport (TQO) 20 min ($60).
